description: Canonical definitions for the n8n nodes the Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp adapters share. scripts/sync-n8n-shared-nodes.ts copies these into docs/n8n-JSON/*-Integration.json, and lib/n8n/workflow-drift.test.ts fails if any adapter has drifted. Edit a definition here, run `npm run n8n:sync`, then re-import the affected workflows into n8n. Nodes whose parameters contain %%PLATFORM%% are written once per channel with that token replaced by the channel name.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO "chatbot"."ChatSession" ("id", "chatbotId", "sessionId", "platform", "guestName", "profilePhoto", "createdAt", "updatedAt")
VALUES (
  'cs_' || md5(random()::text || clock_timestamp()::text),
  '{{ $json._upsert.chatbotId }}',
  '{{ $json._upsert.sessionId }}',
  '%%PLATFORM%%',
  '{{ $json._upsert.guestName }}',
  NULLIF('{{ $json._upsert.profilePhoto }}', ''),
  NOW(),
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT ("chatbotId", "sessionId")
DO UPDATE SET
  "guestName"    = EXCLUDED."guestName",
  "profilePhoto" = COALESCE(EXCLUDED."profilePhoto", "chatbot"."ChatSession"."profilePhoto"),
  "updatedAt"    = NOW();
